text: HC Sibir's official site lists the Government of Novosibirsk Oblast as the club's founder; 'НОВОСИБИРСКАЯ ОБЛАСТЬ' appears on the lower back of the 2026-27 playing jersey.
short: Novosibirsk Oblast government is HC Sibir's founder and appears on the jersey's lower back.

source.name: HC Sibir official site: Founders and partners
source.note: Page has no publication date; fetched 2026-10-03. 'При поддержке: Правительство Новосибирской области' also appears in the site-wide footer.
